title: NFL Week 7 Best Bets & Expert Picks: 5 Must-Bet Games, Longshot TDs & Parlays! (Ep. 1110)
transcript_summary: Seth Woolcock and Andrew Erickson share their top NFL Week 7 best bets, covering spreads, totals, longshot touchdown props, same-game parlays, and Polymarket predictions.

speaker_segments.speaker: Seth Woolcock
speaker_segments.text: Welcome into the BettingPros NFL Podcast. Week 8 best bets are here, joined by Andrew Erickson after a clean sweep last week.

speaker_segments.speaker: Andrew Erickson
speaker_segments.text: The brooms are out! Perfect 5-0 sweep on sides and totals last week. Tre Tucker clutch touchdown pushed the Raiders/Bills game over.

speaker_segments.speaker: Seth Woolcock
speaker_segments.text: Great week all around. Let's get right into Week 7 picks and keep the momentum rolling.

speaker_segments.speaker: Andrew Erickson
speaker_segments.text: My first play is Packers at Lions Over 52.5 points. Ford Field is the Coors Field of the NFL. Lions games at home average 62.4 points, and totals over 52 this season are 6-1 to the over.

speaker_segments.speaker: Seth Woolcock
speaker_segments.text: I was pulled off the over because Green Bay has gone under in three straight, but the pace numbers for both teams make a lot of sense.

speaker_segments.speaker: Andrew Erickson
speaker_segments.text: Next play: Vikings -5.0 vs. Colts. Minnesota coming off a bye gets all weapons back (Jefferson, Addison, Mason, Hockenson). Indianapolis secondary is decimated by injuries.

speaker_segments.speaker: Seth Woolcock
speaker_segments.text: Is there any dead cat bounce angle for the Colts with Chris Ballard out as GM? Probably not enough to stop Minnesota.

speaker_segments.speaker: Seth Woolcock
speaker_segments.text: My best bet is 49ers -3.0 at Falcons. SF has covered five of six games. Brock Purdy faces a low hurry rate from Atlanta's defense, while Penix and the Falcons offense continue to struggle on third downs.

speaker_segments.speaker: Andrew Erickson
speaker_segments.text: Line feels short. Fred Warner has completely transformed SF's defense and erases mobile QBs and tight ends.

speaker_segments.speaker: Andrew Erickson
speaker_segments.text: Next pick: Chiefs +3.0 at Seahawks. Patrick Mahomes as an underdog is 13-3-1 ATS (79%). Sam Darnold has 7 INTs in 4 games. Plus, Kenneth Walker revenge game against his former team.

speaker_segments.speaker: Seth Woolcock
speaker_segments.text: Chiefs defense and Walker's usage make Kansas City very appealing getting points.

speaker_segments.speaker: Andrew Erickson
speaker_segments.text: Final best bet: Eagles +4.5 vs. Cowboys. Home divisional underdogs are 7-2 ATS this year and 19-5 overall. Dallas has underwhelmed in back-to-back prime time games.

speaker_segments.speaker: Seth Woolcock
speaker_segments.text: Cowboys have been one of the most disappointing teams in 2026, so taking points with Philadelphia makes sense.

speaker_segments.speaker: Seth Woolcock
speaker_segments.text: Longshot Special of the Week: Kenneth Walker III 2+ Touchdowns (+500). Walker has scored two touchdowns in 4 of 5 games and gets 100% of red zone RB carries for Kansas City.

speaker_segments.speaker: Andrew Erickson
speaker_segments.text: Revenge narrative in Seattle makes that a fun prop to target.

speaker_segments.speaker: Seth Woolcock
speaker_segments.text: Parlay of the Week (+170): 49ers -3.0 vs. Falcons paired with Christian McCaffrey 5+ Receptions. Atlanta's linebacker depth is compromised and allows high RB reception totals.

speaker_segments.speaker: Andrew Erickson
speaker_segments.text: Love that call with McCaffrey's high target volume in the passing game.

speaker_segments.speaker: Andrew Erickson
speaker_segments.text: Polymarket Prediction: Green Bay vs. Detroit Over 52.5 points trading at 54%.

speaker_segments.speaker: Seth Woolcock
speaker_segments.text: My Polymarket Prediction: Dolphins vs. Jets Under 39.5 points trading at 51%. Both teams run slow-paced offenses with banged-up skill players.

speaker_segments.speaker: Seth Woolcock
speaker_segments.text: Recapping our full cards for NFL Week 7. Subscribe to BettingPros, leave a thumbs up, and good luck with your bets!
